## Activity

During January 2020, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 338 captures. Activity was recorded against the clinic’s planned sessions, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported capture total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below.

## Image quality

Of the 338 captures, 11 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.3 per cent. The result indicates that most captured images were suitable for grading, while the ungradable images were excluded from assessment. The image-quality measure is reported alongside the activity total to support review of the month’s operational performance.

## Grading

A total of 57 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2 days. This records the central grading turnaround for the month and should be considered with the volume of captures and the ungradable rate. Overall, the report records activity, image quality and grading outcomes for Harbour Eye Clinic during January 2020.
